exposure.needed: which ACME HTTP-01 challenges must be solved against endpoints that resolve to or are reached over IPv6 (DNS and endpoint addressing are runtime state not visible in configuration)

original.statement: cert-manager 1.17.0 fixes the ACME HTTP-01 solver so that it works for IPv6 endpoints, which it previously mishandled.

decision.reason: [ev-4fef58672646] says only that 1.17.0 fixes the ACME HTTP-01 solver for IPv6 endpoints. It does not name any config key, field, flag or version range that marks an affected environment. Whether a challenge is solved against an IPv6 endpoint depends on DNS and network addressing at runtime, which configuration does not show. So an undecidable exposure with runtime-behavior-gap is the right fit, and narrowing it to specific Issuer fields would need details the evidence does not give.
